title: The Atlas
eyebrow: Two Sons · everything mapped so far
subtitle: The whole setting on one board: one column per region, with a heading for each part of the Atlas under every column. Switch parts on and off, search for anything, and click a card to see what it connects to and the wiki text behind it.
intro: One column per region, plus Port, the Spine and Underpass, the border towns, and the world as a whole. Each part of the Atlas adds its own heading under every column, so the board grows downward as parts are added; use the switches to show only the parts you want. Tags on each card list what it connects to. Click a card to draw its lines and read the wiki sentence behind each connection. Dashed tags are uncertain (likely, working or possible); inferred links stay hidden until you tick the box. Nothing here is canon: the wiki page always wins.
